description: Depot memo with a denied-then-asserted pair carrying a value judgment ('isn't about money; it's about the crew deserving ...'), a template concession whose second half is a still-vague limitation, and a time-sense 'While'. The contrast becomes plain sentences keeping both propositions and 'deserving'; the time 'While' stays; the vague 'retention remains a challenge' is not made specific with invented detail and is reported as still vague.
prompt: Clean up memo.md, it sounds machine-written. It's going to the depot crews. Save the edited version to out/memo.md.

files.memo.md:
Subject: Night schedule change

The new night schedule isn't about saving money; it's about the crew deserving a safe drive home after midnight. We will not cut any hours.

While the pilot was encouraging, retention remains a challenge. While the nightly sync ran, I counted 31 late arrivals at the north depot.

checks.note: the denied half (the schedule is not for saving money) is a proposition of its own
the value judgment survives and the time-sense 'While' is left alone
'retention remains a challenge' names no cause or size; after the edit it is still vague, so the reply lists it instead of calling it fixed

controls.name: good
controls.output:
Subject: Night schedule change

The new night schedule gives the crew a safe drive home after midnight, which they deserve. It was not meant to save money. We will not cut any hours.

The pilot was encouraging, but retention remains a challenge. While the nightly sync ran, I counted 31 late arrivals at the north depot.
controls.reply:
Rewrote the "isn't about money; it's about" pair as plain sentences that keep both halves and the point that the crew deserve a safe drive home. Dropped the "While ..., ..." template for the pilot. Left the "While the nightly sync ran" sentence alone: it is about time.

Still vague, listed as a residual rather than fixed: "retention remains a challenge" (and "the pilot was encouraging"). The text does not say what the retention problem is or what made the pilot encouraging. [ASK AUTHOR: what is the retention problem, and what made the pilot encouraging?]
